iot_toolcall.role: family 1, device control by tool calls
iot_toolcall.license_of_source: MIT (Hugging Face dataset card metadata of Home-Assistant-Requests V2 and of V1 acon96/Home-Assistant-Requests)
iot_toolcall.fetched: home_assistant_test_english.jsonl at the revision above; freeze_iot.py rebuilds tools.json, catalog.json, test.jsonl and heldout.jsonl, whose SHA-256 values are in iot_toolcall/selection.json
iot_toolcall.notes: Tool schemas and device inventories come from V2, real requests are kept after strict checks of the gold call, and synthetic requests are generated deterministically from the same schemas and inventories (iot_gen.py). Items are not copied into this repository.

sensor_interp.source: synthetic, generated by sensor_interp/build/sensor_gen.py (version sensor-gen-1); no third-party data
sensor_interp.license: the license of this repository; no third-party license applies
sensor_interp.notes: Items are produced from the split seeds in SPLIT.json; regenerating with the same generator version reproduces the files byte for byte.

burstgpt_arrivals.role: arrival process of all device classes
burstgpt_arrivals.origin: parameters fitted to a public trace; the trace is not shipped
burstgpt_arrivals.source: BurstGPT, arXiv 2401.17644, file BurstGPT_1.csv of version v2.0 (SHA-256 begins with 4bb37836), API log
burstgpt_arrivals.license_of_source: not recorded in the project files
burstgpt_arrivals.notes: Two-state Markov-modulated Poisson process, rate ratio 11.78 and mean dwell times 247.2 s (calm) and 22.8 s (burst).

workload.role: device classes, request mix and arrival parameters of the testbed clients
